part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `Factory::applyUnitWithoutOverflow` (src/Carbon/Factory.php:887): when an immutable instance overflowed the bound, it returned the overflowed date as-is instead of clamping to the bound — because `modify()`/`setTimezone()` work fine on immutable objects (returning new instances), the `DateTimeImmutable` early-return was both unnecessary and wrong. Removing it makes the same clamp-to-bound path apply to mutable and immutable instances alike.

Verified:
- `tests/CarbonImmutable/SettersTest.php::testSetUnitNoOverflowFebruary` (FAIL_TO_PASS) now passes
- `tests/Carbon/SettersTest.php` (61 tests) and the full `tests/Carbon`, `tests/CarbonImmutable`, `tests/Factory` suites (4048 tests) all pass
